price.quote: Pricing varies depending on the build level and component package. The Vado 3 X 4.0 starts at around US $5,500, while the higher-spec Vado 3 X 6.0 climbs to approximately $8,000.

cls.quote: CLASS 3 ⟶ Pedal assist only, top speed of 28mph
cls.basis: ERIK'S dealer page for Vado X 3 4.0; its EBIKE CLASSIFICATION block marks Class 3 with the selected checkmark (checked in the page HTML); the 28mph is the class definition, not a stated top speed

tq.quote: That means Specialized’s latest 3.1 motor system remains at the heart of the bike, producing up to 810W of peak power and 105 Nm of torque. Those are seriously healthy numbers for a commuter-oriented e-bike and are heavily derived from the company’s Levo electric mountain bike platform.

wh.quote: Battery ⟶ Specialized Turbo X2 840Wh integrated battery pack

range.quote: Specialized 3.1 motor w/ 810 W & 105 Nm, 840 Wh Battery with up to 150 km range ⟶ Tires

load.quote: MIK 25 kg rear rack with integrated elastics, MIK front rack 10kg compatible (not included) ⟶ Headlight
